results.comment: 11:26 Piers is manipulative and corrupt as hell. If Tate were a little more educated and caught a few of Piers’s manipulated facts with actual counter facts, he would have completely won the argument against a much stronger opponent in terms of debate experience and tactics. Tate did nail that, but Piers didn’t accept it and tried to ride the confidence of being factually correct on one cherry picked issue to be correct overall. Any reasonable person could see Piers was wrong, but Tate didn’t quite prove it in the debate to anyone watching and confidently enough hold his ground there and continue to call Piers out. There are many examples of Israelis raping and brutally executing Palestinians such as in the Safsaf massacre which included a brutal rape of a 14yo Palestinian girl.
